description: This file defines the Scaffold class for Flask's sansio mode, including route registration, error handling, and request lifecycle management.

classes.name: Scaffold
classes.description: Represents a Flask application or blueprint with route registration, error handling, and request lifecycle management.

methods.name: setupmethod
methods.description: Decorator to wrap methods with setup logic.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a Scaffold instance with configuration parameters.

methods.name: add_url_rule
methods.description: Registers a URL rule for routing requests.

methods.name: endpoint
methods.description: Decorator to register a view function for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: before_request
methods.description: Registers a function to run before each request.

methods.name: after_request
methods.description: Registers a function to run after each request.

methods.name: teardown_request
methods.description: Registers a function to run when the request context is popped.

methods.name: context_processor
methods.description: Registers a template context processor function.

methods.name: url_value_preprocessor
methods.description: Registers a URL value preprocessor for all view functions.

methods.name: url_defaults
methods.description: Registers a callback for URL defaults for all view functions.

methods.name: errorhandler
methods.description: Registers a function to handle errors by code or exception.

methods.name: register_error_handler
methods.description: Attaches an error handler function for a specific code or exception.

methods.name: _get_exc_class_and_code
methods.description: Determines the exception class and code for error handling.

methods.name: _endpoint_from_view_func
methods.description: Returns the default endpoint name for a view function.

methods.name: _find_package_path
methods.description: Finds the filesystem path containing a package or module.

methods.description: Finds the installation prefix and import path of a package.
